title: Vibrant Crisp Greek Lamb Skewers
description: A nutty and crisp Greek dish featuring ginger cordial and lardons-render, perfect for adventurous eaters, this recipe is also diabetic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together ginger cordial, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the rendered lardons onto the lamb cubes.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through and slightly charred.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh oregano and lemon wedges.
